The '''Hyperdrive Cantina''' was a floating [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the water [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorusku]]. It was occasionally frequented by thugs working for [[Jalla Spree]], as well as the [[Blue Star Pirates]].
